checks: search result starts real audio and queues all visible results
natural ended advances to the next search result
second natural ended advances without skipping or stalling
repeat off leaves the last track finished rather than auto-looping
play after completion restarts the completed track
repeat-one starts the same track again after real completion
repeat-all wraps from the final result to the first
crossfade also advances the search queue on the other audio deck
search result remains playable after completion and transitions
quick search suggestions queue all shown track matches
natural ended also advances from a quick search suggestion
environment: Linux Chromium; actual generated 2-second WAV media, natural ended events; no live catalogue claims.
